title: This Tiny Cat Reacts to Every AI Task You Complete #aiaccessories #desktop #wholesome
description:
Boost your coding productivity with Komnyang, a desktop pixel cat that tracks your workflow.

This app provides real-time visual feedback on AI agent activity and keeps you focused with built-in Pomodoro timers. Whether you use macOS or Windows, this tool adds a fun, interactive layer to your development environment.

Download the app and customize your cat's reactions to match your coding style today.
